en.title: FBI Investigates Service Selling Over 153 Million Driver's License Records
en.hook: The FBI launches a major investigation into an illegal platform selling over 153M driver's license records.
key_takeaways: Investigation targets an illicit service selling 153M+ driver's license records
Aims to dismantle dark web identity theft networks trading sensitive PII
Underscores the severity of massive data breaches and the urgent need for credential monitoring

再次敲响大规模数据泄露警钟，凸显提升个人数据安全防护的紧迫性
